question: Which of the following was the debutant team in the ICC Women T20 World Cup 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thailand.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Thailand was the debutant team in the ICC Women's T20 World Cup 2020.**
 
• This was the **first time **Thailand participated in the ICC Women's T20 World Cup.
 
• **Thailand played in Group B alongside heavyweights like Australia, India, New Zealand, and Sri Lanka.**
 
• Although Thailand did not win any matches, they put up a spirited performance and earned respect from fans and opponents alike.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **International Cricket Council** (ICC), which oversees the sport, organizes the ICC Women's T20 World Cup.
 
• The inaugural event was held in** England in 2009.**
 
• There will also be **twelve teams** competing in the **2026 tournament.**
 
• **Bangladesh** has played in all the previous editions of the ICC Women's T20 World Cup.
 
• Ireland has played in four previous editions of the ICC women's T20 World Cup.
 
• Afghanistan does not have a women's national cricket team, and hence, did not participate in the ICC women T20 World Cup.
